description: Iteration 3: refine it02_s00 (best, S 1.047): keep fast discharge, lower swarm k to cut M3/var_to_mean, raise red-running and early-start probabilities, enlarge the sidewalk seeker group with an earlier trigger, restore the box hold of the closest box archetype.

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car (0.70 s vs 0.39 s in it02_s00, the best car result) and M5/length: kept the it02_s00 car values that gave the shortest car headway; impatience 0 keeps M3/share/car and M2/early/car near 0.
M1/car: a tight-following minority pulls the mean car headway toward 0.39 s; no red-running attributes because M3/share/car is about 0.003.

M3/share/moto (0.038 vs 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (1.6 vs 4.4): impatience 0.7 and a 6 s drive-after-red time at 7 m/s let more riders keep going on red; M1/moto and M5/length: minimum tau/minGap/minGapLat with lcSublane 5 keep the fast, dense discharge of it02_s00.
Behaviour 10 / M6/approach moto: small slow-rider group at speedFactor 0.9 (unchanged from it02_s00) keeps M4/lat_moto close (7.19 vs 7.085 m) without lengthening queues.

M10a/per_cycle (0.03 vs 0.27) and M9a/per_cycle (0.34 vs 0.33 at it02_s00): the seeker share rises from 0.10 to 0.15 so more riders can use the sidewalk, while the right-lane probability is lowered to hold M9a; they also contribute red running for M3/per_cycle.

M7a/release_time (-11.9 s in it02_s00 vs 0.6 s in it02_s03 with the same jmTimegapMinor 1.0, minGap 0.5, sigma 0.3) and M7b/clear_lag (5.1 vs 6.65 s): these it02_s03 values gave the least negative release time and a clear lag within one observed-day distance.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto (0.025 vs 0.13): more than half of the attempts ended with red before crossing, so the full 10 s window with v_max 5 m/s and a higher p 0.8 lets more front-row riders cross early; cars excluded (M2/early/car 0.001).
M3/per_cycle (1.6 vs 4.4) and M3/share/moto (0.038 vs 0.092): base probability rises from 0.25 to 0.4; M3/var_to_mean (3.1 vs 1.31) was too clustered, so the follower gain k drops from 0.08 to 0.03.

M10a/per_cycle (0.03 vs 0.27): trigger lowered from 20 m to 10 m (observed choice queue 12.7 m) and p_sidewalk 0.08 on 15 percent seekers; M9a/M9b: p_right_lane 0.006 compensates for the earlier trigger so M9a stays near 0.33 and M9b/share_blocked near 0.02; p_wrong_lane 0 because it is inapplicable on this net (R27).
M7a/release_time (0.6 s in it02_s03 vs 2.59 s observed) and M7c/slope (0.18 vs 0.33 s/veh): a longer extra hold of 2.5 s moves box exit later; M7b/clear_lag stays near 6.65 s.
Behaviour 10 / M6/approach moto: slow riders keep the lane centre; unchanged for the 5 percent group, M4/lat_moto already close.
